cards.example_en: Nobody noticed the kitten sleeping behind the sofa.
cards.example_zh: 没人注意到睡在沙发后面的小猫。
cards.explain_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数；本身含否定意义。

cards.example_en: The doctor will examine your sore throat today.
cards.example_zh: 医生今天会检查你疼痛的喉咙。

cards.example_en: Please lay the clean towels on the bathroom shelf.
cards.example_zh: 请把干净毛巾放在浴室架子上。
cards.explain_zh: 放置用lay–laid–laid；躺下用lie–lay–lain。

cards.example_en: Investment in early childhood education can lay the foundations for a more skilled and adaptable workforce.
cards.example_zh: 投资幼儿教育可以为培养技能更强、适应力更高的劳动力奠定基础。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The train picked up speed as we left town.
cards.example_zh: 我们离开小镇时，火车加快了速度。
cards.explain_zh: speed up表示加快；speed也可作动词指超速驾驶。

cards.example_en: My uncle loves discussing politics over dinner with friends.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔喜欢在晚餐时和朋友们讨论政治。
cards.explain_zh: 指政治活动时通常配单数谓语；政治立场可配复数。

cards.example_en: Please reply before Friday so I can book dinner.
cards.example_zh: 请在周五之前回复，好让我预订晚餐。
cards.explain_zh: reply to后接人或消息，不直接接宾语。

cards.example_en: Museums increasingly display everyday objects to illustrate how ordinary people lived in the past.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆越来越多地展示日常物品，以呈现过去普通人的生活方式。
cards.explain_zh: on display意为“在展出”，中间不加冠词。

cards.example_en: Please transfer the photos from your camera to my laptop.
cards.example_zh: 请把相机里的照片传到我的笔记本电脑上。
cards.explain_zh: 名词重音在首音节；过去式transferred双写r。

cards.example_en: This quiet corner is perfect for reading after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 这个安静的角落特别适合午饭后看书。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词重音在前；动词读/pəˈfekt/（英）。

cards.example_en: This quiet corner is perfect for reading after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 这个安静的角落特别适合午饭后看书。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please open the window slightly; it feels warm.
cards.example_zh: 请把窗户稍微打开一点，感觉有些热。
cards.explain_zh: 可修饰形容词、比较级或动词，如slightly higher。

cards.example_en: The overall cost includes breakfast and a train ticket.
cards.example_zh: 总费用包括早餐和一张火车票。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词放名词前；副词可放句首概括整体情况。

cards.example_en: The overall cost includes breakfast and a train ticket.
cards.example_zh: 总费用包括早餐和一张火车票。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I intend to finish painting the kitchen this weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我打算这周末刷完厨房。
cards.explain_zh: intend to do表示打算做；be intended for表示供……用。

cards.example_en: Each user can choose a different colour for their profile.
cards.example_zh: 每位用户都可以为自己的个人资料选择不同的颜色。
cards.explain_zh: use作动词及user中的s读/z/。

cards.example_en: Healthcare systems must respond quickly to changing population needs while maintaining high standards of care.
cards.example_zh: 医疗体系必须迅速回应不断变化的人口需求，同时维持高水平的医疗服务。
cards.explain_zh: respond to后接回应对象，不能直接接宾语。

cards.example_en: Dinner is ready, so please bring the plates.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭做好了，请把盘子拿来。
cards.explain_zh: 日常说 have dinner，不加冠词；正式宴会可说 a dinner。

cards.example_en: We took a slow walk along the river.
cards.example_zh: 我们沿着河边慢慢散步。
cards.explain_zh: slow多作形容词；修饰一般动作通常用slowly。

cards.example_en: Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
cards.example_zh: 公共交通扩建进展缓慢，可能会削弱通勤者放弃私家车的意愿。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our dog needs regular walks to stay happy and healthy.
cards.example_zh: 我们的狗需要经常散步，才能保持快乐和健康。
cards.explain_zh: regular侧重规律或经常，不等于持续不停的continuous。

cards.example_en: Gardening gives me plenty of physical exercise every weekend.
cards.example_zh: 每个周末做园艺活都让我得到充分的身体锻炼。
cards.explain_zh: physical偏身体或物质；physiological指生理的。

cards.example_en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
cards.example_zh: 我们把这些小树间隔两米种下。
cards.explain_zh: apart from可指“除外”或“除……还”，需看语境。

cards.example_en: Living apart from their families can make international students more independent, but may also cause loneliness.
cards.example_zh: 与家人分开生活可以让留学生更加独立，但也可能带来孤独感。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Would an earlier appointment suit you better tomorrow?
cards.example_zh: 明天把预约时间提前一点会更适合你吗？
cards.explain_zh: suit强调合适或好看；fit强调尺寸合身。

cards.example_en: On Sundays, students can enter the federal museum in the capital free.
cards.example_zh: 周日，学生可以免费进入首都的联邦博物馆。

cards.example_en: The last chapter will reveal the answer.
cards.example_zh: 最后一章会揭示答案。

cards.example_en: What percentage of your monthly income goes on rent?
cards.example_zh: 你每月收入的百分之多少用于付房租？
cards.explain_zh: 数字后用percent；谈比例用percentage。

cards.example_en: I enjoy the peace of this garden before breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 我喜欢早餐前这座花园里的宁静。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；peace of mind表示安心、心安。

cards.example_en: Lasting peace depends on cooperation between communities and fair access to essential resources.
cards.example_zh: 持久和平有赖于各群体之间的合作以及公平获取基本资源的机会。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her new role gave her higher status at work.
cards.example_zh: 新职位提高了她在工作中的地位。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指社会地位，也可指当前状况，注意语境。

cards.example_en: Better street lighting has helped reduce crime here.
cards.example_zh: 更好的街道照明帮助减少了这里的犯罪。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指犯罪不可数；指具体罪行可数，如commit a crime。

cards.example_en: As public transport improves, private car use may decline, reducing congestion and air pollution in urban areas.
cards.example_zh: 随着公共交通改善，私家车使用量可能下降，从而缓解城市拥堵和空气污染。
cards.explain_zh: 下降用decline in；婉拒做某事用decline to do。

cards.example_en: They have lived on this street for a decade.
cards.example_zh: 他们在这条街上已经住了十年。
cards.explain_zh: a decade是十年；decades常泛指数十年。

cards.example_en: Over the past decade, digital technology has significantly changed how people access education and healthcare.
cards.example_zh: 过去十年间，数字技术显著改变了人们获取教育和医疗服务的方式。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Schools should launch awareness campaigns to encourage healthier eating habits and reduce food waste among students.
cards.example_zh: 学校应开展宣传活动，鼓励学生养成更健康的饮食习惯，并减少食物浪费。
cards.explain_zh: 推出产品、发起活动和发射卫星都可用launch。

cards.example_en: Please warn me if the pan gets too hot.
cards.example_zh: 如果锅太烫，请提醒我。
cards.explain_zh: warn后可接that从句；warn sb not to do表示告诫。

cards.example_en: As a consumer, I always compare prices before buying.
cards.example_zh: 作为消费者，我总会在购买前比较价格。
cards.explain_zh: consumer强调消费身份；customer强调与商家的交易关系。

cards.example_en: Advertising can influence consumer behaviour in different ways.
cards.example_zh: 广告能够以不同方式影响消费者行为。

cards.example_en: Could you do me a favor and water my plants?
cards.example_zh: 你能帮我个忙，给我的植物浇水吗？
cards.explain_zh: favor是美式拼写，英式为favour；帮忙用do a favor。

cards.example_en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
cards.example_zh: 毛巾在阳光下晾过后已经干了。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词比较级drier；名词dryer指烘干设备。

cards.example_en: Long periods of dry weather can damage crops and threaten food security in agricultural communities.
cards.example_zh: 长期干旱天气会损害农作物，并威胁农业社区的粮食安全。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My dance partner waited patiently while I practised.
cards.example_zh: 我练习时，我的舞伴耐心地等着。
cards.explain_zh: partner不表明性别；作动词常用partner with。

cards.example_en: My dance partner waited patiently while I practised.
cards.example_zh: 我练习时，我的舞伴耐心地等着。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My sister works at a respected institution near home.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐在家附近一家备受尊重的机构工作。
cards.explain_zh: 可指具体机构，也可指婚姻等社会制度。

cards.example_en: Every educational institution should provide accessible facilities and appropriate support for students with disabilities.
cards.example_zh: 每所教育机构都应提供无障碍设施，并为残障学生提供适当支持。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We found a shady spot beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 我们在河边找到了一处阴凉的地方。
cards.explain_zh: on the spot可指“当场”或“在现场”，依语境判断。

cards.example_en: The brown horse gently took an apple from my hand.
cards.example_zh: 那匹棕色的马轻轻地吃走了我手里的苹果。
cards.explain_zh: 骑马用ride a horse；on horseback表示骑在马上。

cards.example_en: After searching every room, we eventually found the missing keys.
cards.example_zh: 搜遍每个房间后，我们终于找到了丢失的钥匙。
cards.explain_zh: 强调经过时间或困难后的结果，不表示可能。

word.example_en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
word.example_zh: 经常运动能够改善心理健康，并降低几种常见慢性病的患病风险。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: The programme encourages regular physical activity among older adults.
word.example_zh: 这项计划鼓励老年人进行规律的身体活动。

word.example_en: Universities can partner with local businesses to offer students practical experience before they enter the workforce.
word.example_zh: 大学可以与当地企业合作，让学生在就业前获得实践经验。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
